name: betul-district-intelligence
description: Betul District Intelligence & Citizen Benefit Platform

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@betul/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=@betul/validation && npm run build --workspace=@betul/ai-contracts
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@betul/api && npm run build --workspace=@betul/web
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace=@betul/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@betul/web
